description: Copy an image or sound file from this computer into the project: <project>/<folder>/<name>.<ext>. source must be an absolute local path to a regular file (no relative paths, network/UNC shares, devices or symbolic links). The type is read from the file's header, never its extension: img/* folders take files with a PNG header (max 32 MiB; only the signature + IHDR is checked, not the whole image), audio/* folders take files whose header is Ogg (OggS) or ISO-BMFF/M4A (ftyp) (max 128 MiB; only the header is checked, not the codec or the full file); the extension (.png, .ogg, .m4a) is chosen from the detected header. name defaults to the source file name without its extension and must be 1-64 characters from A-Z a-z 0-9 space _ ! $ ( ) - (no dots, no path); a '$' prefix on a character sheet means one character per sheet, '!' means no offset. An existing file with the same name (letter case ignored) is only replaced with overwrite: true; the session backup (list_backups / restore_backup) keeps the file as it was before this server session first touched it (until set_project is called again, which starts the snapshots over), so a file that was itself created or changed earlier in the same session has no backup of that intermediate version. Nothing is converted or resized; warnings flag sheet sizes that do not fit the folder's layout, and for audio a missing sibling format (MV's web build needs both .ogg and .m4a). Refused while a changeset is open (binary files cannot be staged): commit or discard it first.

folder.description: Destination asset folder, e.g. img/characters or audio/bgm

name.description: File name without extension; defaults to the source's base name

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file with this name

source.description: Absolute path of the file to import, e.g. C:\art\Hero.png or /home/me/art/Hero.png

name: import_asset
title: Import asset
